name: Thalia
domains: catalogue node — not the Muse or Charis

summary.text: A Nereid daughter of Nereus and Doris named in Apollodorus among the fifty sea-sisters and in Homer's Iliad among Thetis' mourning companions — not Thalia the Muse nor Thalia the Charis.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Thalia among the Nereids born to Nereus and Doris in the Bibliotheca's long roll of sea-daughters — a catalogue name distinct from the Olympian Muses and from the Graces who share the name.

Homer names Thalia in the bright cave when Thetis grieves: Glauce and Thalia and Cymodoce appear among the daughters of Nereus beating their breasts together. The atlas keeps this figure separate from thalia-muse and thalia-charis — three distinct nodes for three distinct mythological classes.
